title: session_bundle member: har.json (D2: standard HAR 1.2 + _initiator)
description: Complete network traffic including response bodies. Standard HAR 1.2 (full validity is checked by the vendored official schema, approved supplementary choice point 2); each entry carries a custom _initiator field (the HAR specification allows _-prefixed extensions) holding the CDP initiator information, so that Stage 2 can perform the deterministic 'initiator + time + action boundary' join (D3).

_initiator.description: Raw CDP initiator information (facts only, no inference)

type.description: CDP initiator type (e.g. script, parser, other)
